waivers.reason: This release adds a GENERATION-side slot and no new verdict: the scaffold seeds one support line differently on pages that declare a quantitative move, and the rule is enforced by D14, which already gated before this release. No gate was added, removed or re-scoped, so the set of verdicts a driven agent is measured against is unchanged and a fresh multi-agent round would compare the same bar to itself. What the change WOULD show up in is the next round's authoring behaviour, which is the reason to run that round at a big-version milestone rather than now. The board is 18 releases stale and its own tooling was rebuilt in 0.1.642-649; refreshing it is an operator task (install and update the platform CLIs, drive a round) that the owner schedules.
